entries.basis: The project owner authorized the current ERPX-owned source and documentation grant on 2026-10-27. Third-party material and historical source require their own review; this category is not a complete file-level rights audit.
Historical declaration retained. Determine the source rights and any explicit additional grant before reuse or public-history publication.
Existing MIT notice and source lock retained; adapted source must retain required attribution.
Existing Noto Project Authors notices and SIL Open Font License retained.

Factual mapping data generated from the pinned upstream dist/dingbats.js source. The original 2021 Michael Williamson BSD-2-Clause notice, upstream reference and source checksum are retained. No runtime npm import is introduced; the complete transitive release inventory remains pending.

Cargo pins icu_collator and icu_collator_data to 2.1.0, whose CLDR 48 compiled data matches the retained Node 26.11.1 collation-data release. Both published crates carry the byte-identical retained Unicode-3.0 license, including adapted ICU notices. Their registry archive checksums are recorded in Cargo.lock. This reviews these notices only, not the complete transitive Rust release inventory. Finite source-oracle conformance is not a claim that ICU4X and ICU4C implementations are identical for every Unicode input.
The existing README documents fictional AI-generated media and its generation history. Confirm redistribution scope as part of asset review.
Record asset authorship, acquisition and redistribution terms; keep trademark use distinct from the source-code license.
Review screenshots, private paths, provider resource identifiers and personal data. Preserve original dated or checksum-protected evidence and label any public redacted derivatives.
Complete the transitive JavaScript, Rust, native-tool and eventual image dependency/license inventory for the actual release. No complete SBOM or compliance clearance is claimed here.

The pinned published ryu-js crate declares Apache-2.0 OR BSL-1.0. ERPX selects Apache-2.0 and retains its published LICENSE-APACHE byte-for-byte. Cargo.lock records the registry archive checksum. This is a notice review for this direct dependency, not a complete transitive release clearance.

The explicit development worker provider smoke fetches eng/tha traineddata only from the pinned official tessdata_fast revision, checks the recorded byte counts and SHA-256 values, and retains its Apache-2.0 license. Model bytes are ignored and not shipped in this source checkpoint. Operational eng+tha probes do not establish Thai OCR accuracy, complete transitive notices or production release acceptance.

Optional unmodified ldap3_proto 0.8.1 and ldap3_lber 0.8.1 registry dependencies retain their upstream licenses. Pinned source commit, archive hashes and corresponding source URLs are recorded in the local dependency provenance; this entry does not relicense them or declare Directory production readiness. ERPX-owned adapter wrappers retain the current project Apache-2.0 grant; dependency license obligations are recorded separately.
